html:
/* Template:LootTable/styles.css - a loot table made of groups. No table is used (Citizen clips tables, which would cut off the hover cards)
   and no overflow is hidden, so the item cards can open outside the group. */
.aa-loot {
	display: grid;
	gap: 12px;
	margin: 0.8em 0 1.2em;
}
.aa-loot-group {
	--aa-loot-accent: var(--aa-accent, #e28552);
	padding: 12px 14px 14px;
	border: 1px solid var(--aa-edge, rgba(247, 240, 233, .12));
	border-left: 3px solid var(--aa-loot-accent);
	border-radius: 10px;
	background: var(--aa-card, rgba(35, 30, 26, .8));
}
.aa-loot-sure { --aa-loot-accent: #7fb35a; }
.aa-loot-pick { --aa-loot-accent: var(--aa-accent, #e28552); }
.aa-loot-craft { --aa-loot-accent: #6aa7d8; }
.aa-loot-head {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: baseline;
	justify-content: space-between;
	gap: 4px 12px;
}
.aa-loot-title {
	font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
	font-size: 1.25rem;
	font-weight: 700;
	line-height: 1.2;
	color: var(--aa-title, inherit);
}
.aa-loot-note {
	padding: 1px 9px;
	border: 1px solid var(--aa-loot-accent);
	border-radius: 999px;
	font-size: .75rem;
	letter-spacing: .04em;
	color: var(--aa-loot-accent);
	white-space: nowrap;
}
.aa-loot-text {
	margin-top: 4px;
	font-size: .88rem;
	color: var(--aa-muted, #8a8478);
}
.aa-loot-items {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(230px, 1fr));
	gap: 8px;
	margin-top: 10px;
}
.aa-loot-item {
	display: flex;
	align-items: center;
	justify-content: space-between;
	gap: 8px;
	min-width: 0;
	padding: 6px 10px;
	border: 1px solid var(--aa-edge, rgba(247, 240, 233, .12));
	border-radius: 8px;
	background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .18);
}
.aa-loot-name {
	flex: 1 1 auto;
	min-width: 0;
	text-align: left;
	/* a name that wraps stays beside the icon (hanging indent) and not under it */
	padding-left: 30px;
	text-indent: -30px;
}
/* the indent is only for the line of the name itself, not for the pieces inside it (the icon is an inline box that would inherit it) */
.aa-loot-name * { text-indent: 0; }
/* the outline of a tile lights up in the accent colour of the wiki when the pointer is on it */
.aa-loot-item {
	transition: border-color .12s, background-color .12s, box-shadow .12s;
}
.aa-loot-item:hover {
	border-color: var(--aa-accent, #e28552);
	background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .06);
	box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--aa-accent, #e28552);
}
/* the hover card belongs to the whole tile: hovering anywhere on it opens the card, which opens at the right side of the tile and starts halfway down it,
   so the tiles above, below and next to it stay reachable. On a phone (one column) it opens under the tile instead. */
.aa-loot-item { position: relative; }
.aa-loot-item .aa-itemtip { position: static; }
.aa-loot-item:hover .aa-itemtip-card { display: block; }
.aa-loot-item .aa-itemtip-card {
	top: 50%;
	left: 100%;
	right: auto;
	padding: 0 0 0 4px;
	text-indent: 0;
	max-width: 90vw;
}
.aa-loot-chance {
	flex: none;
	font-size: .75rem;
	font-weight: bold;
	color: var(--aa-loot-accent);
}
/* a line across the whole grid, for example the arrow between the materials and the result of a recipe */
.aa-loot-arrow {
	grid-column: 1 / -1;
	text-align: center;
	font-size: .8rem;
	letter-spacing: .06em;
	text-transform: uppercase;
	color: var(--aa-muted, #8a8478);
}
/* a tile in the right most column (marked by Common.js) opens its card at the left side instead */
.aa-loot-item.aa-loot-left .aa-itemtip-card {
	left: auto;
	right: 100%;
	padding: 0 4px 0 0;
}
@media (max-width: 600px) {
	.aa-loot-items { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
	.aa-loot-item .aa-itemtip-card,
	.aa-loot-item.aa-loot-left .aa-itemtip-card {
		top: 100%;
		left: 0;
		right: auto;
		padding: 4px 0 0;
	}
}

/* a crafting recipe: the result on top, the materials under it. Recipes sit in columns on wide screens. */
.aa-loot-craft .aa-loot-items {
	grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(320px, 1fr));
	gap: 14px 10px;
}
.aa-lr {
	display: flex;
	flex-direction: column;
	gap: 6px;
	min-width: 0;
}
.aa-lr-mats {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: baseline;
	gap: 2px 12px;
	padding: 0 4px 0 10px;
	font-size: .88rem;
}
.aa-lr-lbl {
	font-size: .7rem;
	letter-spacing: .08em;
	text-transform: uppercase;
	color: var(--aa-muted, #8a8478);
}
.aa-lr-list {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	gap: 2px 14px;
}
@media (max-width: 600px) {
	.aa-loot-craft .aa-loot-items { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}
